title: Failed assassination attempt on Amenemhat I (Pharaoh's baker and butler)
summary: CFAH AP-60: the failed assassination attempt on Amenemhat I, 1718 BC, which CFAH-6 matches to the trial of Pharaoh's baker and butler (Gen 40).
description: Genesis 40 tells of Pharaoh's chief butler and chief baker imprisoned with Joseph; two full years later Joseph was brought before Pharaoh (Gen 41:1). CFAH-6 dates the trial to 1718 BC and Joseph's promotion to 1716/1715 BC (AP-61).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #60; Argument 4 §6 "Assassination Attempt: Baker and Butler on Trial 1718 BC"
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Failed Assassination Attempt on Amenemhat I"

chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 4)," Biblical Chronology 6:6 (June 1994), §13 year list
chronologies.note: Jordan dates the dreams of the baker and cupbearer (Gen 40) to AM 2287, two years before Joseph stands before Pharaoh in AM 2289 (Gen 41:1).
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
